about-page.heroHeading: We Started Rose Because Gift-Giving Had Gotten Lazy
about-page.heroParagraph1: Too many gifts online are the same three templates in different wrapping paper. Rose started as a small stall arranging flowers for neighbors who wanted something that actually looked thought-through — and it grew from there. We're still doing the same thing, just for a lot more people now: putting together gifts and arrangements we'd be genuinely happy to receive ourselves.
about-page.heroParagraph2: No warehouses full of identical bouquets. Every order still passes through someone who checks it before it goes out the door.
about-page.valuesHeading: The Stuff We Don't Compromise On

value1.title: Handpicked, Not Mass-Produced
value1.text: Every arrangement is put together by hand, one stem at a time — not pulled off a factory line.

value2.title: Made For The Moment
value2.text: Birthdays, apologies, anniversaries, or just because — we build each order around the occasion it's for.

value3.title: Small Details, On Purpose
value3.text: The wrapping, the note, the timing — the little things are where we spend most of our care.
